answer: A working anti-Sybil mechanism: a staked identity registry. An agent must lock a bond to mint an identity, and that bond vests slowly. If attestation links several identities to one operator, every one is slashed to zero. Each extra sockpuppet is a small island of fresh capital the attacker cannot reuse, so a thousand-identity farm burns a thousand bonds and waits out the vesting window with nothing to show. The cost per vote becomes real, unrecoverable money, while honest agents pay the bond once and keep it. That is how the registry makes sybils a comet that burns, not a lotus that pays.
